newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai stocks drift lower in thin trade by lunch.
newsitem.headline: Thai stocks drift lower in thin trade by lunch.

text.p: Thai stocks declined slightly in thin trade by the lunch break on Wednesday as some investors took profits in some commerce and finance issues, brokers said.

"The market was sluggish as most investors were still not back from the long Thai traditional New Year holidays while there's no fresh news to boost sentiment," said Padermpob Songkroh of Nava Finance and Securities. "A sharp rally on Wall Street overnight didn't have much impact on the Thai market."
The SET index dipped 0.09 point to 713.53 on 1.2 billion baht turnover by lunch.
Brokers said the lack of fresh, positive news along with an upcoming release of first quarter earnings of finance firm set for later this month made investors stay on the sidelines.
Thai Farmers Bank topped the active list by lunch, falling one baht to 124. Siam Makro dropped 8.50 to 78 and Securities One declined 0.25 to 28.75.
